# Overview

A markdown to generate all the computational figures for the Blastocystis clonal methods paper after running the `blasto_clonal_methods.smk`.

## Figures 
Main text:

  - Allele Frequency Histogram of the CW Clonal strain and SRR*973
  - Allele Frequency Histogram of the CW mixture strains and SRR*971

Supplemental:
  - BUSCO of the assembly from SRR973 and SRR971
  - Faceted Allele Frequency Histograms of all Blastocystis ST1 strains that are similar to Nand
  - ANI heatmap of the assemblies
  - Metadata file of the Blastocystis ST1 assemblies

# BUSCO figure
```{r}

busco_stats <- 
read_delim("manual_busco_assembly_stats.txt", delim = "\t", col_names = c("assembly", "count", "type")) %>%
  select(-starts_with("X")) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(type, "Total")) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(type, "Complete BUSCOs")) %>%
  mutate(count = as.numeric(count)) %>%
  mutate(prop = count / 129) %>%
  mutate(assembly = fct_relevel(assembly, "Nand", "CW Clonal", "CW Mixture", "SRR20078973 Assembly", "SRR20078971 Assembly")) %>%
  mutate(type = fct_relevel(type, "Missing BUSCOs (M)", "Fragmented BUSCOs (F)", "Complete and single-copy BUSCOs (S)" ,"Complete and duplicated BUSCOs (D)"))

busco_stats %>%
  ggplot(aes(fill = type, y = assembly, x = prop)) +
    geom_col() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = lind_palette, guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
    labs(y = "Assembly", x = "Proportion of total BUSCO groups", fill = "") + 
    theme_cowplot(20) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    background_grid()

```

```{r}
cw_clonal_vcf_df <- cw_clonal_vcf %>% 
  filter(str_length(REF) == 1, str_length(ALT) == 1, !str_detect(ALT, ","), !ALT %in% c("*", ".")) %>%  # filtering for bialleic snps
  filter(gt_GT %in% c("0/1", "0|1", "1/1", "1/0", "1|0")) %>%
  filter(FILTER == "PASS") %>%
  separate_wider_delim(gt_AD, delim = ",", names = c("ref_ad", "alt_ad")) %>%
  mutate(alt_ad = as.numeric(alt_ad)) %>% 
  mutate(ref_ad = as.numeric(ref_ad)) %>% 
  mutate(af = alt_ad / (alt_ad + ref_ad)) %>%
  mutate(depth = alt_ad + ref_ad)

cw_mixture_vcf_df <- cw_mixture_vcf%>% 
  filter(str_length(REF) == 1, str_length(ALT) == 1, !str_detect(ALT, ","), !ALT %in% c("*", ".")) %>%  # filtering for bialleic snps
  filter(gt_GT %in% c("0/1", "0|1", "1/1", "1/0", "1|0")) %>%
  filter(FILTER == "PASS") %>%
  separate_wider_delim(gt_AD, delim = ",", names = c("ref_ad", "alt_ad")) %>%
  mutate(alt_ad = as.numeric(alt_ad)) %>% 
  mutate(ref_ad = as.numeric(ref_ad)) %>% 
  mutate(af = alt_ad / (alt_ad + ref_ad)) %>%
  mutate(depth = alt_ad + ref_ad)

st1_samples_vcf_df <- st1_samples_vcf %>% 
  filter(str_length(REF) == 1, str_length(ALT) == 1, !str_detect(ALT, ","), !ALT %in% c("*", ".")) %>%  # filtering for bialleic snps
  filter(gt_GT %in% c("0/1", "0|1", "1/1", "1/0", "1|0")) %>%
  filter(gt_GQ > 20, QUAL > 20) %>%
  filter(FILTER == "PASS") %>%
  separate_wider_delim(gt_AD, delim = ",", names = c("ref_ad", "alt_ad")) %>%
  mutate(alt_ad = as.numeric(alt_ad)) %>% 
  mutate(ref_ad = as.numeric(ref_ad)) %>% 
  mutate(af = alt_ad / (alt_ad + ref_ad)) %>%
  mutate(depth = alt_ad + ref_ad)

plot_grid(
  cw_clonal_vcf_df %>%
  filter(gt_GT != "1/1") %>%
  filter(QUAL > 20, gt_GQ > 20) %>%
  mutate(sample = "CW clonal") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = af)) + 
    geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(count)),binwidth = 0.02, boundary = 0,fill = "#999999", color = "black") +
    geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(density * n * 0.02)), color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) + 
    facet_wrap(~sample) + 
    labs(x = "Variant Allele Frequency", y = "") + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#2F4B26") + 
    theme_cowplot(20) +
    background_grid(),

  cw_mixture_vcf_df %>%
  filter(gt_GT != "1/1") %>%
  filter(QUAL > 20, gt_GQ > 20) %>%
  mutate(sample = "CW mixture") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = af)) + 
    geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(count)),binwidth = 0.02, boundary = 0,fill = "#999999", color = "black") +
    geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(density * n * 0.02)), color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) + 
    facet_wrap(~sample) + 
    labs(x = "Variant Allele Frequency", y = "") + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#2F4B26") + 
    theme_cowplot(20) +
    background_grid(),

  st1_samples_vcf_df %>%
    filter(gt_GT != "1/1") %>%
  filter(QUAL > 20, gt_GQ > 20) %>%
    filter(str_detect(Indiv, "973")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = af)) + 
    geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(count)),binwidth = 0.02, boundary = 0,fill = "#999999", color = "black") +
    geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(density * n * 0.02)), color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) + 
      facet_wrap(~Indiv) + 
      labs(x = "Variant Allele Frequency", y = "") + 
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#2F4B26") + 
      theme_cowplot(20) +
      background_grid(),
  st1_samples_vcf_df %>%
    filter(gt_GT != "1/1") %>%
  filter(QUAL > 20, gt_GQ > 20) %>%
    filter(str_detect(Indiv, "971")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = af)) + 
    geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(count)),binwidth = 0.02, boundary = 0,fill = "#999999", color = "black") +
    geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(density * n * 0.02)), color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) + 
      facet_wrap(~Indiv) + 
      labs(x = "Variant Allele Frequency", y = "") + 
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#2F4B26") + 
      theme_cowplot(20) +
      background_grid(),

  nrow = 2,
  labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D")
)
```

# Mapping genome

```{r}



# Metadata file of the Blastocystis ST1 assemblies

# Merging tables obtained from ncbi/eukdetect2/etc.

# get samples that were >5x coverage
high_cov_samples <- read_tsv("data/samtools-coverage-table.tsv") %>%
  select(sample = Sample, mean_cov = `Mean depth`) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_cov)) %>%
  mutate(sample = str_replace(sample, "_alignment_cov", "")) %>%
  filter(mean_cov > 5)

# read in all bioprojects and samples within
all_samples_ncbi <- list.files(path = "data/ena_reports", pattern = "filereport_read_run*", full.names = TRUE) %>%
  map(read_delim, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows()


eukdetect2_mapping <- read_csv("data/blasto_st1_no_other_blastos_top_100_rpksb.csv") %>%
  select(label, lifestyle, sample, species, rpksb)


assembly_report <- stream_in(file("data/assembly_data_report.jsonl", encoding = "UTF-8"),
  flatten = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(accession, assemblyInfo.assemblyName, assemblyInfo.submitter,assemblyInfo.bioprojectAccession, assemblyInfo.sequencingTech,assemblyInfo.biosample.accession, assemblyInfo.biosample.geoLocName)

genome_source_map <- read_csv("data/genome_source_map.csv")

blasto_map <- high_cov_samples %>%
  left_join(all_samples_ncbi, by = c("sample" = "run_accession")) %>%
  select(sample, mean_cov, study_accession, sample_accession, experiment_accession) %>%
  left_join(eukdetect2_mapping, by = c("sample")) %>%
  left_join(assembly_report, by = c("sample_accession" = "assemblyInfo.biosample.accession")) %>%
  left_join(assembly_report %>% mutate(sample_name_merge = str_remove(assemblyInfo.assemblyName, "_.*")), by = c("sample" = "sample_name_merge")) %>%
  mutate(genome = coalesce(accession.x, accession.y)) %>% 
  mutate(assemblyName = coalesce(assemblyInfo.assemblyName.x, assemblyInfo.assemblyName.y)) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".x"), -ends_with(".y")) %>%
  select(-assemblyInfo.biosample.accession) %>%
  left_join(
    genome_source_map %>% 
      select(accession, submitter, location),
      by = c("genome" = "accession")
  ) %>%
  mutate(genome_file = str_c(genome, "_", assemblyName, "_genomic")) %>% 
    filter(mean_cov >= 10) %>%
    mutate(data_type = "") %>%
    select(sample, mean_cov, data_type, assemblyName, study_accession, sample_accession, genome, location)

```



# Allele Frequency Histograms of all Blastocystis ST1 strains that are similar to Nand

```{r}



st1_samples_vcf_df %>%
  left_join(blasto_map, by = c("Indiv" = "sample")) %>%
  filter(mean_cov > 10) %>% 
  filter(gt_GT != "1/1") %>%
  filter(QUAL > 20, gt_GQ > 20) %>%
  mutate(facet_label = str_c(Indiv, "\n Coverage: ", round(mean_cov,2), "x")) %>%
  mutate(facet_label = fct_reorder(facet_label, mean_cov)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = af)) + 
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = after_stat(count)),
    binwidth = 0.02, boundary = 0,
    fill = "#999999", color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_density(
    aes(y = after_stat(density * n * 0.02)),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(x = "Variant Allele Frequency", y = "Count") +
    facet_wrap(~facet_label, scales = "free_y", nrow = 3, ) + 
    labs(x = "Variant Allele Frequency", y = "") + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#2F4B26") + 
    theme_cowplot(15) +
    background_grid()

```



# ANI heatmap of the Blastocystis ST1 assemblies

```{r}

genome_map <- read_csv("/storage/home/hcoda1/1/jshih41/r-alind6-0/projects/blast_analysis/data/genome_source_map.csv")

genomes_keep <- blasto_map %>%
  mutate(genomic_file = str_c(genome,"_" ,assemblyName)) %>%
  pull(genomic_file)


labels <- genome_map %>% 
  filter(ani_assigned_st == 1) %>%
  mutate(genome_id = str_replace(genome_id, ".sorted.bam", "")) %>%
  mutate(genome_id = str_replace(genome_id,"results/bam/","")) %>%
  mutate(accession = str_replace(accession, "\\.1", "")) %>%
  mutate(heat_label = str_c(accession, "_", location)) %>%
  mutate(genome_id = str_replace(genome_id, "_genomic", "")) %>%
  select(genome_id, heat_label)

fastani_out <- read_tsv("/storage/home/hcoda1/1/jshih41/r-alind6-0/projects/blasto_clonal_methods_analyses/final_results/fastani_all.tsv", col_names = FALSE) %>%
    set_names(c("genome1", "genome2", "ani", "numerator","denominator")) %>% 
    mutate(genome1 = str_replace(genome1, "/storage/home/hcoda1/1/jshih41/r-alind6-0/data/all_ncbi_blast_genomes/", "")) %>%
    mutate(genome2 = str_replace(genome2, "/storage/home/hcoda1/1/jshih41/r-alind6-0/data/all_ncbi_blast_genomes/", "")) %>%
    mutate(genome1 = str_replace(genome1, "_genomic.fna", "")) %>%
    mutate(genome2 = str_replace(genome2, "_genomic.fna", ""))

mat <- fastani_out %>%
  select(genome1, genome2, ani) %>%
  left_join(
    blasto_map %>%
      mutate(genomic_file = str_c(genome,"_" ,assemblyName)) %>%
      select(sample1 = sample, genomic_file),
      by = c("genome1" = "genomic_file")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    blasto_map %>%
      mutate(genomic_file = str_c(genome,"_" ,assemblyName)) %>%
      select(sample2 = sample, genomic_file),
      by = c("genome2" = "genomic_file")
  ) %>%
  mutate(sample1 = ifelse(is.na(sample1), genome1, sample1)) %>%
  mutate(sample2 = ifelse(is.na(sample2), genome2, sample2)) %>%
  select(-genome1, -genome2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample2, values_from = ani, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample1") %>%
  as.matrix()


row_dendro <- hclust(dist(mat))
ordered_names <- rownames(mat)[row_dendro$order]

fastani_out %>%
  left_join(
    blasto_map %>%
      mutate(genomic_file = str_c(genome,"_" ,assemblyName)) %>%
      select(sample1 = sample, genomic_file),
      by = c("genome1" = "genomic_file")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    blasto_map %>%
      mutate(genomic_file = str_c(genome,"_" ,assemblyName)) %>%
      select(sample2 = sample, genomic_file),
      by = c("genome2" = "genomic_file")
  ) %>%
  mutate(sample1 = ifelse(is.na(sample1), genome1, sample1)) %>%
  mutate(sample2 = ifelse(is.na(sample2), genome2, sample2)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(sample1, levels = ordered_names), y = factor(sample2, levels = ordered_names), fill = ani)) + 
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "PRGn", direction = 1) +
    theme_cowplot(20) +
    labs(x= "", y = "") + 
    background_grid() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

```


## exporting figures

```{r}

combined_figure3 <-
plot_grid(
  busco_stats %>%
  ggplot(aes(fill = type, y = assembly, x = prop)) +
    geom_col() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = lind_palette, guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
    labs(y = "Assembly", x = "Proportion of total BUSCO groups", fill = "") + 
    theme_cowplot(12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    background_grid(),

  plot_grid(
    cw_clonal_vcf_df %>%
    filter(gt_GT != "1/1") %>%
    filter(QUAL > 20, gt_GQ > 20) %>% 
    mutate(sample = "CW clonal") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = af)) +

      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +

      geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#2F4B26") + 
      theme_cowplot(12) +
      background_grid(),

    cw_mixture_vcf_df %>%
    filter(gt_GT != "1/1") %>%
    filter(QUAL > 20, gt_GQ > 20) %>% 
    mutate(sample = "CW mixture") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = af)) + 
      geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(count)),binwidth = 0.02, boundary = 0,fill = "#999999", color = "black") +
      geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(density * n * 0.02)), color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) + 
      facet_wrap(~sample) + 
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,1)) +
      labs(x = "Variant Allele Frequency", y = "") + 
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#2F4B26") +

    st1_samples_vcf_df %>%

      # filter(depth > lower_quant, depth < upper_quant) %>%
```
